title: KnownIssues
description: Schema for known issues tracked by the test automation framework

scenario.description: Target scenario short name or wildcard pattern (e.g. 'signIn.WrongPassword' or 'signIn.login.partners.addNew.random.absentData.*')

title.description: Jira ticket ID or issue title (e.g. 'NODEJS-3113')

description.description: Summary or description of the problem

link.description: URL to the issue tracker ticket

pattern.description: Log or exception pattern for automated matching
